paite: Huan sepaih pawl heutute leh Kareah tapa Johanan leh Hoshaiah tapa Jezaniah leh mipi tengteng, aneupen a kipan a alianpen tan in ahong nai ua, zawlnei Jeremiah kiang ah:
heading: Mipite'n Amau Thumsak Ding In Jeremiah Angen Uh
english: Then all the captains of the forces, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and Jezaniah the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least even to the greatest, came near,

paite: "Na ma ah ka ngetna uh pom hi henla, hiai akhosuaksun mi tengteng a ding ngei in na Pathian kiang a hon thumsak ding in ka hon ngen uhi; na hon muh bang ngei in mi tampite lak a kipan tawmchik kia nutsiat in ka omta uh.
english: and said to Jeremiah the prophet, Please let our supplication be presented before you, and pray for us to Yahweh your God, even for all this remnant; for we are left but a few of many, as your eyes do see us:

paite: TOUPA na Pathian in ka paina ding thil uh hon kawkmuh theihna ding in," achi uhi.
english: that Yahweh your God may show us the way in which we should walk, and the thing that we should do.

paite: Huchi in zawlnei Jeremiah in akiang uah, "Na thu uh ka za hi, ngai un, na thu uh bangbang in TOUPA na Pathian kiang uah ka ngen ding hi; huan, hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N nou ahon dawn peuhmah ka hon hilh zel ding; na lak uah bangmah ka iim kei ding," achi hi.
english: Then Jeremiah the prophet said to them, I have heard you; behold, I will pray to Yahweh your God according to your words; and it shall happen that whatever thing Yahweh shall answer you, I will declare it to you; I will keep nothing back from you.

paite: Amau Jeremiah kiang ah, "TOUPA na Pathian in ka kiang ua nang ahon sawlna thu tengteng bang zel a ka hih kei uleh ka lak uah TOUPA thu theipa dik leh muanhuai hi hen.
english: Then they said to Jeremiah, Yahweh be a true and faithful witness among us, if we don’t do according to all the word with which Yahweh your God shall send you to us.

paite: Asia hiam apha hiam ka hon sawlna uh TOUPA ka Pathian uh paukam suak ka mang ngeingei ding uh; TOUPA ka Pathian uh paukam suak ka man uleh kou hoihtheihna ding ahi,” achi uhi.
english: Whether it be good, or whether it be evil, we will obey the voice of Yahweh our God, to whom we send you; that it may be well with us, when we obey the voice of Yahweh our God.

paite: Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, ani sawm nung in TOUPA thu Jeremiah kiang ah ahong tung a.
heading: Jeremiah Thumna TOUPA'N Adawng
english: It happened after ten days, that the word of Yahweh came to Jeremiah.

paite: Huchi in Kareah tapa Johanan leh akiang asepaih heutu om tengteng leh sepaih tengteng, aneupen a kipan alianpen tan in asam a, akiang uah,
english: Then called he Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, and all the people from the least even to the greatest,

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh, ama a na ngetna uh tun dia na hon sawlna pa un hichi in achi:
english: and said to them, Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to present your supplication before him:

paite: Hiai gam a na omdet uleh ka hon tungding ding a, ka hon phelzak kei ding, ka hon phutkip ding a, ka hon botkhe kei ding, na tung ua thil hoih lou ka tutte lah ka lungheita ngal a.
english: If you will still live in this land, then will I build you, and not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck you up; for I grieve over the distress that I have brought on you.

paite: Babulon kumpipa na lau sek uh lau nawn kei un, amah lau kei un chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; akhut a kipan noute hondam ding leh hunkhe ding in na kiang uah ka om hi.
english: Don’t be afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom you are afraid; don’t be afraid of him, says Yahweh: for I am with you to save you, and to deliver you from his hand.

paite: Na tung ua zah angaihtheihna ding in zahngaihna nou ka hon phal ding a, na gam mah uah ka hon kiksak ding hi.
english: I will grant you mercy, that he may have mercy on you, and cause you to return to your own land.

paite: Himahleh, hiai gam ah i om kei ding uh, chi a TOUPA na Pathian uh aw na man louh ua,
english: But if you say, We will not dwell in this land; so that you don’t obey the voice of Yahweh your God,

paite: "Ahi het lou Aigupta gam ah i pai zaw ding ua, huai ah kidouna himhim i tuak kei ding a, pengkul ging leng i za kei ding a, an taksapna a-om sam kei ding, huai ah i teng zaw ding uh," na chih uleh,
english: saying, No; but we will go into the land of Egypt, where we shall see no war, nor hear the sound of the trumpet, nor have hunger of bread; and there will we dwell:

paite: Aw Judah khosuaksunte aw, TOUPA thu ngai dih ua; sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi:
english: now therefore hear the word of Yahweh, O remnant of Judah: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, If you indeed set your faces to enter into Egypt, and go to live there;

paite: Aigupta gam a lut ding leh huai a teng ding a kihei teitei na hih uleh hichi ahong hi ding a, namsau na kihtak ngei un Aigupta gam ah hon pha ding a, kial na kihtak sek un leng Aigupta gam ah nou ahon delhzui ding a, huai ah na si ding uh.
english: then it shall happen, that the sword, which you fear, shall overtake you there in the land of Egypt; and the famine, about which you are afraid, shall follow close behind you there in Egypt; and there you shall die.

paite: Aigupta gam a teng ding a kihei teiteite tengteng huchibang in a-om ding ua, namsau, kial leh hipi in na si ding uh, thil hoih lou atung ua ka tut ding a kipan kuamah asuakta un abit kei ding uh.
english: So shall it be with all the men who set their faces to go into Egypt to live there: they shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence; and none of them shall remain or escape from the evil that I will bring on them.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in huchi in achi hi, "Jerusalem a tengte tung a ka hehna ka sun mah bang in Aigupta gam na lut hun chiang un na tung uah ka hehna ka sung sam ding; hamsethuak leh lamdangsak chiat, mi kamse banna, gensiat na hi ding ua, hiai mun na mu nawn kei ding uh.
english: For thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: As my anger and my wrath has been poured forth on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so shall my wrath be poured forth on you, when you shall enter into Egypt; and you shall be an object of horror, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach; and you shall see this place no more.

paite: "Aw Judah khosuaksunte aw, TOUPA'N na tungtang uh agenta hi, Aigupta gam ah lut kei un, hiai ni in nou ka hon theichiansak ahi chih thei mahmah un. Na hinna uh,
english: Yahweh has spoken concerning you, remnant of Judah, Don’t you go into Egypt: know certainly that I have testified to you this day.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang ah na hon sawl ua, TOUPA ka Pathian uh kiang ah hon thumsak inla, TOUPA ka Pathian un achihchih hon hilh inla, ka hih zel ding uhi na chi ngal ua.
english: For you have dealt deceitfully against your own souls; for you sent me to Yahweh your God, saying, Pray for us to Yahweh our God; and according to all that Yahweh our God shall say, so declare to us, and we will do it:

paite: Tuni in na kiang uah ka puangta ahi; himahleh na kiang ua ahon sawlna bangmah in TOUPA na Pathian uh paukam lah na mang ngal kei ua.
english: and I have this day declared it to you; but you have not obeyed the voice of Yahweh your God in anything for which he has sent me to you.

paite: Huaiziak in tu'n zaw theita un, tenna na lunggulhna mun ngei uah namsau, kial leh hipi in na si ngeingei ding uh," chi in achi hi.
english: Now therefore know certainly that you shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, in the place where you desire to go to live there.
